title: Norwegian Flatbread with Cumin Crust
description: A traditional Norwegian flatbread with a twist of French cuisine, infused with the warm flavor of cumin.
instructions: Roll out the flatbread dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Mix the ground cumin with a pinch of salt and sprinkle evenly over the dough.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until it's golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Cut the flatbread into smaller pieces and serve warm.
Optional: brush the flatbread with melted butter or olive oil for added flavor.
